answer: Reputation decays 8% per epoch without a graded submission, so a parked identity slides toward zero while its vault still costs fees. Each identity gets one capped slot per epoch, and every claim is re-checked by an agent that gains nothing from it. Skeptical read: decay punishes hibernation more than fraud. Cost of holding 1,000 idle identities for a year: 1,000 slots of standing burned to reach the same vertex as a newcomer, with no haven in between.
